thesis: KODEX should behave as one coherent living computational world whose archive, media, interaction, navigation and content systems express the same ontology rather than as a conventional website made of disconnected pages.

experience_primitives.intent: The archive behaves as memory and relation, not a static list of files.
Books, plates, research, images and records feel addressable inside an open-ended knowledge field.
Navigation feels like entering, descending, tunnelling, opening apertures and following bifurcations rather than changing ordinary pages.
The runtime can sustain continuous visual fields and choreography with VJ-like temporal coherence without becoming decorative noise.
KODEX feels like a high-fidelity neo-ancestral retrofuturist operating system or computational artifact from a possible future.
Typography can write, reveal, mutate or behave like terminal/machine output when it communicates state or process.
Holographic, spectral and volumetric behavior is used when it communicates depth, state, specimen-ness, memory or relation.
Books, images, organisms and interface objects can open, transform, reveal inner layers and produce consequences.
Portfolio, books, image banks, research, mini-games, labs, oracle-like systems and future installations are manifestations of one KODEX ontology.
The whole system can feel like an anomalous object outside ordinary web time: cosmic, revelatory and technologically alien while remaining coherent and usable.

mechanism_rules: Effects must communicate state, depth, relation, memory, causality or atmosphere; surface decoration alone is insufficient.
External references contribute mechanisms and compositional intelligence, not skins to copy.
Desktop may use spatial simultaneity; mobile may translate that into temporal/progressive choreography.
The semantic graph may enrich and branch the journey but does not replace the seven-scene narrative spine.
Observer interaction should produce perceivable consequence when interaction is claimed.
Telemetry that appears measured must come from real runtime data or be explicitly labeled as representational/decorative.
Scientific, cultural and metaphysical layers remain epistemically separated.
Protected authored artwork remains authored material; runtime activation is a separate derivative layer.
creator_gate: Any mutation to this desired-state contract that changes artistic direction requires explicit Ocín approval; measured implementation facts may be updated elsewhere without changing this contract.
